stock.description: IMS Group Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, concentrating on the design and provision of cutting-edge light-emitting diode (LED) lighting solutions. The firm caters primarily to high-end luxury retail establishments throughout Hong Kong, mainland China, the broader Asian market, Europe, and other international locations. Beyond merely supplying fixtures, IMS Group delivers an extensive suite of integrated LED lighting services. These include initial system conceptualization, expert advisory, continuous maintenance, post-delivery enhancements, on-site project oversight, and strategic consultancy. The company further diversifies its portfolio by offering various visual-audio systems, such as conferencing, projection, public address, sound masking, and centralized control setups. Additionally, it supplies 3D printing materials and provides 3D printing services. Founded in 1998, IMS Group Holdings Limited is based in North Point, Hong Kong.
